name: Padme
reason: Too thin: identified as Padme (Padmae-ini, born Megan Sievert), a Sivananda-trained yoga teacher and sacred painter whose own site artyogatravel.org names Omega Institute among past workshop venues; but the site offers only one undated yantra-painting workshop, art sales and 'stay tuned' retreats, with no videos, books or free resources and no published base, so fewer than 3 items. Contact form at https://artyogatravel.org/contact; site found via https://sivanandabahamas.org/presenter/padme/.
